verdict.rationale: Customer.io documents its own in-product agent. It builds segments from a plain-text 'Describe segment' prompt, analyzes the workspace, runs recurring scheduled tasks (Daily Routines), and can take work via Slack, so delegation to a built-in assistant is directly supported. The breadth of tasks delegable inside the app UI is only thinly documented; the MCP server and CLI drive external AI clients and are not built-in, so they are not credited here. missing for 10: detailed docs on the in-app agent's full task scope (e.g., building automations or drafting messages from within the product UI), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the built-in agent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: When you go to create a segment, you can click **Describe segment** and the agent will help you build a segment from a plain-text description.
The agent can analyze your workspace
You can set up recurring tasks that the agent runs automatically on a schedule—like deliverability reports, segment audits, and broadcast recaps.
You can add the Customer.io agent to Slack, and ask it questions or give it work without leaving a thread.
